mapper.select: SELECT id,title,sort_order AS `order`,imageUrl,redirectUrl,isEnabled,isDeleted,createTime,updateTime FROM Carousels WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id,title,sort_order AS `order`,imageUrl,redirectUrl,isEnabled,isDeleted,createTime,updateTime FROM Carousels WHERE isDeleted = false ORDER BY `sort_order` ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Carousels (title, `sort_order`, imageUrl, redirectUrl, isEnabled, isDeleted) VALUES (#{title}, #{order}, #{imageUrl}, #{redirectUrl}, #{isEnabled}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE Carousels SET isDeleted = true WHERE id = #{id}
